requirements.title: Milestone boundary and invariant
requirements.summary: Clinical records and prescriptions on the web. Synthetic-only implementation; retain doctor ownership, independent secretary grants and separate patient identity/relationship/encounter; no clinical/legal/provider/commercial authority inferred.
requirements.provenance: Supplied roadmap v0.2 plus current delegated scope.

requirements.title: Clinical workflow and prescribing policy sign-off
requirements.summary: Approve encounter, amendment, signing and delegable drafting policy with a qualified clinician; no medical recommendation is generated. Acceptance: Record accountable clinician, review date, encounter state transitions and which actions may be drafted by staff versus signed by a doctor; unresolved professional authority remains explicit. Define amendment/revocation, patient release and conflict rules for synthetic workflows; retain original signed material and audit actor/time. Produce a signed decision record or leave clinical governance OPEN; neither a developer nor a test run can supply clinical approval. Prepare evidence for DOS-M2-GATE-CLINICAL. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-001 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Encounter lifecycle and visit provenance
requirements.summary: Implement draft/in-progress/finalized/amended encounters with doctor, location, patient and time attribution. Acceptance: Create distinct encounter identity referencing the practice-patient relationship, responsible doctor and encounter location; never make a location the chart owner. Authorize draft/in-progress/finalized/amended transitions on the server with version comparison and idempotency keys; finalized content cannot be overwritten. Persist actor, event time, originating encounter/version and amendment reason; archived locations and patients retain referenced history.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-002 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: History, allergies and structured intake
requirements.summary: Capture clinician-reviewed history/allergies/vitals with provenance, correction and permission rules. Acceptance: Represent patient-reported, staff-entered and clinician-reviewed observations separately with source, timestamp and unit; distinguish unknown, none-reported and missing allergy/history fields. Correct observations through a traceable revision; unreviewed data must not render as verified and no values or diagnoses are inferred. Apply encounter/practice and delegated intake permissions consistently to history, allergies and observations; clinician review requires the approved actor capability.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-003 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Clinical note templates and specialty-neutral forms
requirements.summary: Provide typed clinical forms and configurable templates without claiming coverage of every specialty. Acceptance: Define versioned neutral note sections and typed field schemas with explicit optional/required fields approved by governance; do not silently claim specialty coverage. Persist the template version with each note so later template edits do not rewrite historical content. Use shared page templates for editing/review, retain unsaved content on validation/network failure and require explicit conflict resolution.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Medication catalogue source and licensing contract
requirements.summary: Select an approved catalogue/manual-entry policy, provenance and update workflow; do not invent EDA API access. Acceptance: Record candidate catalogue owner, license/redistribution restrictions, allowed fields, version, provenance, update cadence and access evidence; unavailable APIs remain unavailable. Define explicit clinician-entered manual entries and unverified identity labeling where approved; no scraping, EDA access or commercial license is assumed. Approve a versioned catalogue/manual-entry contract with withdrawal/update behavior and retain the licensing decision OPEN until evidence is supplied. Prepare evidence for DOS-M2-GATE-CATALOGUE. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Structured prescription builder
requirements.summary: Capture medicine identity, strength, form, dose, route, dates, frequency and instructions with clinician review. Acceptance: Persist medicine identity/provenance, entered strength/form/dose/unit/route, start/end, structured frequency and clinician-authored instructions without filling clinical values automatically. Validate required shape and internal consistency, associate each draft with encounter and responsible doctor, and surface unresolved medicine identity explicitly. Retain draft edits with version checks; save is not signing and no validation result implies that a dose or medicine is clinically appropriate.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-006 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Complex schedules and schedule validation
requirements.summary: Represent tapering, every-N-hours, selected weekdays and as-needed instructions without deriving unapproved medical advice. Acceptance: Model explicit schedule segments for tapering, interval, selected weekdays and as-needed instructions with boundaries, timezone semantics and versioned representation. Detect overlapping/contradictory segments and ambiguous time anchors for clinician correction; never calculate a replacement dose or infer an as-needed dosing cadence. Preserve exact entered regimen through serialization and amendments; provide deterministic test vectors reviewed under the prescribing policy.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-007 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Clinician review, signing and immutable versions
requirements.summary: Enforce accountable finalization, revoke/amend workflow and immutable prior prescription versions. Acceptance: Require the approved accountable doctor and current authorization for signing; invitations, editable metadata and staff grants cannot confer signing authority. Atomically store immutable signed version, signer and time, source draft/version and integrity reference; repeated signing is idempotent and stale signing fails. Revocation/amendment creates a linked version and reason with old content preserved; downstream consumers can distinguish active, superseded and stopped versions.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-008 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Prescription print and patient-safe sharing
requirements.summary: Render readable bilingual-capable print/share output from structured data with scoped access and no public patient exposure. Acceptance: Render print output from one signed structured version with doctor, patient, location, date, version/status and unmodified instructions; bilingual layout must remain legible. Use shared pure print presentation and UX-owned download behavior; app adapters perform current permission checks. Sharing is scoped, revocable and expiry-aware with no public patient metadata, static storage URL or analytics payload; a stopped/superseded version is visibly labeled.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-009 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Follow-up plans and order requests
requirements.summary: Capture clinician-authored follow-up, lab/imaging and referral requests without interpreting results. Acceptance: Store clinician-authored follow-up, lab, imaging and referral requests with encounter/doctor attribution, due context and explicit lifecycle. Separate request creation, operational tracking and clinical interpretation; a result or referral never silently creates a diagnosis. Allow only authorized transitions and cancellation with history; external provider calls remain absent until M9 approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-010 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Results and clinical document review
requirements.summary: Track uploaded/requested/received/reviewed/released states and clinical attribution. Acceptance: Track requested/uploaded/received/reviewed/released states with explicit actor/time and source-file provenance. Validate private document type/size and access on upload/view/download; replacements retain prior version and audit link. Only the approved clinician can mark review or release; upload success does not imply review, normality or patient visibility.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-011 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Clinical record release and patient visibility rules
requirements.summary: Separate private working material, released patient content and caregiver access policy. Acceptance: Define per-record release decision separate from chart membership; private working notes and released patient artifacts are distinct projections. Record recipient relationship, version, release actor and revocation policy; future caregiver grants are explicit scoped relationships, not shared credentials. Backend queries expose only authorized released versions; linking a patient to two doctors does not expose either doctor chart to the other.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-012 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Clinical export and amendment integrity
requirements.summary: Export authorized complete records with version/provenance and preserve audit/retention rules. Acceptance: Export only the authorized doctor/practice/patient scope with encounter, signed version, amendment chain, document provenance and manifest completeness. Use stable IDs and deterministic manifest checksums so omissions and mismatched versions are detectable; export access is current and audited. Preserve retention/legal-hold policy gates and historical versions; this task creates a synthetic export, not a real-data erasure policy.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-013 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Clinical workflow safety acceptance
requirements.summary: Verify synthetic end-to-end encounters/Rx/orders and obtain independent clinical review before any live use. Acceptance: Run the complete synthetic encounter→intake→note→prescription→sign/amend→print/release→result/export workflow against exact candidate code. Obtain independent qualified clinical review of entered-data fidelity, authority boundaries and failure cases; unresolved critical findings block acceptance. Record all M2 requirements and gate evidence separately from product implementation; no real-patient or prescribing launch is authorized.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M2-014 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

arguments.p_description:

Requirements

- DOS-M2-F001: Approve encounter, amendment, signing and delegable drafting policy with a qualified clinician; no medical recommendation is generated. Produce a signed decision record or leave clinical governance OPEN; neither a developer nor a test run can supply clinical approval. Prepare evidence for DOS-M2-GATE-CLINICAL. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.

4. Prepare evidence for DOS-M2-GATE-CLINICAL. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.

Execution boundaries
- Synthetic identities and patient records only. No real patient data, credentials, hosted product migrations, provider purchases, deployments, merges or main promotion are authorized.
- Doctor owns the practice across locations. Secretary memberships and grants remain independent per doctor and location. Patient identity, doctor relationship and encounter are separate; phone/email equality never merges identities or shares charts.
- Use the pinned Nuxt/Vue/pnpm monorepo and root lockfile. Every web route renders one registered complete packages/ui template; shared interactions belong in packages/ux; app adapters own queries and domain logic. Never import other apps or add Suit-local Vue composition/CSS.
- Read current root and scoped AGENTS plus git preflight before implementation. Work only in assigned worktree and allowed paths. Preserve history and unrelated edits. Worker leaves verification/publication to control plane; no worker commits or pushes.
- No automatic diagnosis, prescribing, dose advice, medication substitution, clinical efficacy claims or guaranteed notifications. Evidence-dependent clinical, legal, provider, commercial and mobile choices remain explicit gates.
- No task execution until parent confirms all nine milestones safely stored and the relevant real blocking start decision is explicitly resolved. Saving/importing plans does not authorize execution or release.
- The user has authorized eventual implementation of M1, M2 and M3 after all nine plans are safely saved. This is not authorization to bypass genuine clinical/provider gates, retry the cancelled live-schema refresh, use real patients or activate live clinical care.
- M1–M3 completion means checked implementation in GitHub with exact-candidate verification evidence. The user handles Vercel and hosted Supabase connections; those connections or deployments are not completion requirements for the authorized synthetic implementation. Genuine domain approvals still gate dependent capabilities.
- Routine authority/document/scope/disabled-operation/status checks use independent automated exact-candidate verification, with no additional human acknowledgement. Existing approvals may be checked but not invented or replaced by automation.

Provide typed clinical forms and configurable templates without claiming coverage of every specialty.

Requirements

- Synthetic identities and patient records only. No real patient data, credentials, hosted product migrations, provider purchases, deployments, merges or main promotion are authorized.
- Doctor owns the practice across locations. Secretary memberships and grants remain independent per doctor and location. Patient identity, doctor relationship and encounter are separate; phone/email equality never merges identities or shares charts.

- Read current root and scoped AGENTS plus git preflight before implementation. Work only in assigned worktree and allowed paths. Preserve history and unrelated edits. Worker leaves verification/publication to control plane; no worker commits or pushes.

- No task execution until parent confirms all nine milestones safely stored and the relevant real blocking start decision is explicitly resolved. Saving/importing plans does not authorize execution or release.
- The user has authorized eventual implementation of M1, M2 and M3 after all nine plans are safely saved. This is not authorization to bypass genuine clinical/provider gates, retry the cancelled live-schema refresh, use real patients or activate live clinical care.
- M1–M3 completion means checked implementation in GitHub with exact-candidate verification evidence. The user handles Vercel and hosted Supabase connections; those connections or deployments are not completion requirements for the authorized synthetic implementation. Genuine domain approvals still gate dependent capabilities.
- Routine authority/document/scope/disabled-operation/status checks use independent automated exact-candidate verification, with no additional human acknowledgement. Existing approvals may be checked but not invented or replaced by automation.

arguments.p_description:
Enforce accountable finalization, revoke/amend workflow and immutable prior prescription versions.

Requirements

Acceptance: Require the approved accountable doctor and current authorization for signing; invitations, editable metadata and staff grants cannot confer signing authority. Atomically store immutable signed version, signer and time, source draft/version and integrity reference; repeated signing is idempotent and stale signing fails. - Use the pinned Nuxt/Vue/pnpm monorepo and root lockfile. Every web route renders one registered complete packages/ui template; shared interactions belong in packages/ux; app adapters own queries and domain logic. Never import other apps or add Suit-local Vue composition/CSS.

- M1–M3 completion means checked implementation in GitHub with exact-candidate verification evidence. The user handles Vercel and hosted Supabase connections; those connections or deployments are not completion requirements for the authorized synthetic implementation. Genuine domain approvals still gate dependent capabilities.
- Routine authority/document/scope/disabled-operation/status checks use independent automated exact-candidate verification, with no additional human acknowledgement. Existing approvals may be checked but not invented or replaced by automation.

Execution boundaries
- Synthetic identities and patient records only. No real patient data, credentials, hosted product migrations, provider purchases, deployments, merges or main promotion are authorized.
- Doctor owns the practice across locations. Secretary memberships and grants remain independent per doctor and location. Patient identity, doctor relationship and encounter are separate; phone/email equality never merges identities or shares charts.
- Use the pinned Nuxt/Vue/pnpm monorepo and root lockfile. Every web route renders one registered complete packages/ui template; shared interactions belong in packages/ux; app adapters own queries and domain logic. Never import other apps or add Suit-local Vue composition/CSS.
- Read current root and scoped AGENTS plus git preflight before implementation. Work only in assigned worktree and allowed paths. Preserve history and unrelated edits. Worker leaves verification/publication to control plane; no worker commits or pushes.
- No automatic diagnosis, prescribing, dose advice, medication substitution, clinical efficacy claims or guaranteed notifications. Evidence-dependent clinical, legal, provider, commercial and mobile choices remain explicit gates.
- No task execution until parent confirms all nine milestones safely stored and the relevant real blocking start decision is explicitly resolved. Saving/importing plans does not authorize execution or release.
- The user has authorized eventual implementation of M1, M2 and M3 after all nine plans are safely saved. This is not authorization to bypass genuine clinical/provider gates, retry the cancelled live-schema refresh, use real patients or activate live clinical care.
- M1–M3 completion means checked implementation in GitHub with exact-candidate verification evidence. The user handles Vercel and hosted Supabase connections; those connections or deployments are not completion requirements for the authorized synthetic implementation. Genuine domain approvals still gate dependent capabilities.
- Routine authority/document/scope/disabled-operation/status checks use independent automated exact-candidate verification, with no additional human acknowledgement. Existing approvals may be checked but not invented or replaced by automation.
